/**
 * @file
 *
 * @brief Zephyr testing assertion macros.
 */

#ifndef ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_
#define ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is true.
 *
 * The zassert_true() macro asserts that the @a cond expression is true.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param cond Condition to check.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_true(cond, msg, ...) \
	zassert(cond, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is false.
 *
 * The zassert_false() macro asserts that the @a cond expression is false.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param cond Condition to check.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_false(cond, msg, ...) \
	zassert(!(cond), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is null.
 *
 * The zassert_is_null() macro asserts that the @a cond expression is null.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param cond Condition to check.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_is_null(cond, msg, ...) \
	zassert((cond) == NULL, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is not null.
 *
 * The zassert_not_null() macro asserts that the @a cond expression is not null.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param cond Condition to check.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_not_null(cond, msg, ...) \
	zassert((cond) != NULL, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two integers are equal.
 *
 * The zassert_equal() macro asserts that the two integers @a a and @a b are
 * equal.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param a First integer.
 * @param b Second integer.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
	zassert((a) == (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two integers are not equal.
 *
 * The zassert_not_equal() macro asserts that the two integers @a a and @a b are
 * not equal.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param a First integer.
 * @param b Second integer.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
	zassert((a) != (b), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory buffers have the same contents.
 *
 * The zassert_mem_equal() macro asserts that the @a len bytes of the two memory
 * buffers @a buf1 and @a buf2 have the same contents.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param buf1 First memory buffer.
 * @param buf2 Second memory buffer.
 * @param len Number of bytes to compare.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_mem_equal(buf1, buf2, len, msg, ...) \
	zassert_true(memcmp(buf1, buf2, len) == 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory buffers have different contents.
 *
 * The zassert_mem_not_equal() macro asserts that the @a len bytes of the two
 * memory buffers @a buf1 and @a buf2 have different contents.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param buf1 First memory buffer.
 * @param buf2 Second memory buffer.
 * @param len Number of bytes to compare.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_mem_not_equal(buf1, buf2, len, msg, ...) \
	zassert_true(memcmp(buf1, buf2, len) != 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory buffers have the same contents, with string-like details.
 *
 * This is equivalent to zassert_mem_equal(), but if the assertion fails, the
 * details will be printed as if the buffers were strings. This is useful for
 * comparing buffers that are not NUL-terminated.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param buf1 First memory buffer.
 * @param buf2 Second memory buffer.
 * @param len Number of bytes to compare.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_mem_equal_str(buf1, buf2, len, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		const char *b1 = (const char *)buf1; \
		const char *b2 = (const char *)buf2; \
		if (memcmp(b1, b2, len) != 0) { \
			ztest_print_str_equal(b1, b2, len); \
			ztest_fail_message(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two strings are equal.
 *
 * The zassert_str_equal() macro asserts that the two strings @a s1 and @a s2
 * are equal.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param s1 First string.
 * @param s2 Second string.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_str_equal(s1, s2, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		const char *s1_ = (s1); \
		const char *s2_ = (s2); \
		if (strcmp(s1_, s2_) != 0) { \
			ztest_print_str_equal(s1_, s2_, 0); \
			ztest_fail_message(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two strings are not equal.
 *
 * The zassert_str_not_equal() macro asserts that the two strings @a s1 and @a s2
 * are not equal.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param s1 First string.
 * @param s2 Second string.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_str_not_equal(s1, s2, msg, ...) \
	zassert_true(strcmp(s1, s2) != 0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is within a given memory buffer.
 *
 * The zassert_within() macro asserts that the pointer @a ptr is within the
 * buffer starting at @a base of size @a size.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param ptr Pointer.
 * @param base Start of the buffer.
 * @param size Size of the buffer.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_within(ptr, base, size, msg, ...) \
	zassert((ptr) >= (base) && (ptr) < ((base) + (size)), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is not within a given memory buffer.
 *
 * The zassert_not_within() macro asserts that the pointer @a ptr is not within
 * the buffer starting at @a base of size @a size.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param ptr Pointer.
 * @param base Start of the buffer.
 * @param size Size of the buffer.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_not_within(ptr, base, size, msg, ...) \
	zassert(!((ptr) >= (base) && (ptr) < ((base) + (size))), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Unconditionally fail a test.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param msg Optional message to print.
 */
#define zassert_unreachable(msg, ...) \
	zassert(0, msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two float numbers are equal.
 *
 * The zassert_float_equal() macro asserts that the two float numbers @a a and @a b are
 * equal.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param a First float number.
 * @param b Second float number.
 * @param delta Maximum allowed difference between @a a and @a b.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_float_equal(a, b, delta, msg, ...) \
	zassert(ztest_check_float_equal(a, b, delta), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two double numbers are equal.
 *
 * The zassert_double_equal() macro asserts that the two double numbers @a a and @a b are
 * equal.
 *
 * If the assertion fails, the test function is terminated.
 *
 * @param a First double number.
 * @param b Second double number.
 * @param delta Maximum allowed difference between @a a and @a b.
 * @param msg Optional message to print if the assertion fails.
 */
#define zassert_double_equal(a, b, delta, msg, ...) \
	zassert(ztest_check_double_equal(a, b, delta), msg, ##__VA_ARGS__)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_ */
